explanation: A playable-interstitial-style app ad for a fictional travel brand, Roam. Designed-UI composition: solid brand field + accent shape + app screen in a device frame + rendered copy, button and an interactive chip row. Each frame is one chip state (Hotels / Villas / Cabins) — tapping a chip swaps the featured stay, so the interaction itself tells the story.

frame_1.description: Hotels state: brand field with accent circle behind the phone; app screen shows a boutique city hotel; Hotels chip selected.

frame_2.description: Villas state: same layout, app screen swaps to a hillside villa; Villas chip selected.

frame_3.description: Cabins state: app screen swaps to a lakeside cabin; Cabins chip selected; CTA carries the close.
